page.overview:
Who is Darmin?

is an old man patronizing the Gemmed Hearth in Kamordah. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.

Darmin is very, very old, with an almost folded face, missing all of his teeth. His jaw scoops forward and overlaps the front a bit.

When the Mighty Nein encountered him at the Gemmed Hearth in Kamordah, it was difficult to tell if he was deaf or just disinterested in them.

When the Mighty Nein entered the Gemmed Hearth Inn, Darmin was the only patron seated at one of the five tables available. Fjord tried to speak with him from a distance but Darmin didn't respond. Fjord then tried to get closer but when Darmin saw the half-orc, he got very scared so Fjord backed off directly. Caleb Widogast asked Darmin about the news in Kamordah, but the old man understood the word "noose" instead and replied there hadn't been hanging in town for about four years.
